lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in multiple vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with a higher density of smaller clusters concentrated near the dorsal-lateral boundary.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular high-luminance blobs, forming a semi-regular grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal feature with a sharp vertical intensity gradient—exhibiting high luminance on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower—runs along the upper third of the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear indentation with a high-contrast dark-to-light gradient is visible on the mid-flank posterior to the gill slits, indicating a deep tissue depression or scar.
